chapter.verse: Leitang leh a tunga omte, leitung leh a tunga teengte in Topa aa hi;
bang hang hiam cih leh amah in tuipite tungah a bul phut a, gunte tungah kipsak hi.
Topa ’ mual tungah kuate kah ding ahi hiam? Ama mun siangtho-ah kuate ding ding ahi hiam?
Khut siangtho leh lung siangtho a nei, a man lo-ah a nuntakna pia loin, khemna tawh a kiciam lo mite ahi hi.
Amah in Topa tung panin thupha ngah ding a, amah a honkhia Pasian kiang panin diksakna ngah ding hi.
Tua bang mite pen, amah a zong, Jakob’ Pasian’ mai a zong minam ahi hi.
Minthang Kumpipa hong tum theih nadingin, khua kongpite aw, na lute uh sangsak un! Taanglai kong khakte aw, kilaamto un!
Minthang Kumpipa kua ahi hiam? Hat-a a vanglian Topa, galhat Topa ahi hi.
Mihing Kumpipa hong tum theih nadingin, khua kongpite aw, na lute uh sangsak un! Taanglai kong khakte aw, kilaamto un!
Hih minthang Kumpipa kua ahi hiam? Vanglianpen Topa, minthang Kumpipa ahi hi.
